note: The script asks for five graphics: the optional section words PAST, PRESENT and FUTURE, and the two one-word answers as big centred text. Every other row is the face with no text, and the logo is only on the end card.

mg.title: Past section word
mg.cue: Section word PAST at 00:04, lower left, small, 2 s.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:04 and hold it 2 seconds. Move it lower left and keep it small. The script marks it optional.

mg.title: Present section word
mg.cue: Section word PRESENT, lower left, 2 s.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:38, when this row starts, and hold it 2 seconds. Move it lower left and keep it small. The script marks it optional.

mg.title: Future section word
mg.cue: Section word FUTURE, lower left, 2 s.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:54, when this row starts, and hold it 2 seconds. Move it lower left and keep it small. The script marks it optional.

mg.title: Rooted big word
mg.cue: The word as big centred text over her face: rooted.
mg.use: Big word in the center, over her face. The script wants it for 1 second, so cut it with her shot at 01:10.

mg.title: Unbroken big word
mg.cue: Big centred text: Unbroken. Same style. 1 s.
mg.use: Big word in the center, over her face, same style as rooted. The script wants it for 1 second, so cut it with her shot at 01:11.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Logo from the brand assets Andrés sent (25 Sep). The logo appears here only.
mg.src: AIJ's own Vertical Animated logo (Mobile Video).mp4 from the AIJ Outros/Intros pack (Drive), the newest outro AIJ has given us.
mg.use: This is the end card, the client's own file. Put it at 01:14 after the last line and use it exactly as it is. The script asks for the AIJ 30 Years lockup; AIJ has only sent it inside the 30th style guide PDF, so use this animation until a lockup file arrives.
